proposals.title: Rewrite derived-layer.md materialization claims
proposals.summary: items/derived-layer.md still says outputs are materialized into a PostGIS table with a Refresh button, scheduled refresh, last-run wall time/row count, a 5M-row save acknowledgement, and ArcGIS service streaming inputs. Code composes on-the-fly read SQL (featureLimit default 1000, hard ceiling 50_000); DerivedLayerDetail shows live re-run copy with no Refresh UI; source kinds are data_layer | derived_layer only. Soften help to match the live pipeline + Analyze shortcut list that already is honest.
proposals.rationale: Playbook ethos: honest about what we ship. Strongest leftover honesty gap after R16 basemap composed-map. Front-door derived-layer help oversells a warehouse path the read path does not use.
proposals.risk: Docs-only. Keep Analyze shortcut catalog and pipeline step list accurate. Do not invent Refresh/schedule UI. CHANGELOG Documentation; skip What's new unless the help card summary changes enough to notice.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest about on-the-fly PostGIS derived layers. Prefer PostGIS shapes that exist today.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Rewrite Materialization / Inputs / Cost sections; CHANGELOG docs note; skip What's new unless card text warrants it.

proposals.title: Rewrite measure.md away from a fake Custom Web App widget
proposals.summary: help/web-apps/widgets/measure.md describes a Custom Web App Measure widget with Coordinate/MGRS/UTM, planar mode, snap-to-features, and secondary units. CustomWidgetKind has no measure kind. Measure ships as a Viewer tool, Editor tool, and map-builder MeasureTool (geodesic length/area, optional terrain surface area, pitch flatten while open). Retarget the page to those surfaces and drop widget-config claims the builder cannot set.
proposals.rationale: Honesty oversell after R16. Widget catalog help invents a page-widget that is not in the type union while the real map Measure path is under-documented.
proposals.risk: Docs-only (or move file under items/map / viewer help and fix frontmatter id/related). Do not build a Custom Web App measure widget. Document pitch-flatten + ground/surface area only where code exists. CHANGELOG Documentation; skip What's new unless the help card moves categories.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest about Measure as viewer/editor/map tool, not Experience Builder widget parity.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Rewrite measure help to Viewer/Editor/map Measure; remove fake widget config; CHANGELOG docs note.

proposals.title: Analyze run history shelf on the source data layer
proposals.summary: Thin vertical: on a data_layer Analyze panel, list this user's derived_layer items whose data.source.itemId matches the current item (fetch type=derived_layer&full=1&mine=1&limit=50 and client-filter, or add an optional sourceItemId list filter later). Each row shows title, createdAt, first pipeline tool label, link to the derived item. Re-run duplicates the same DerivedLayerData via POST /items (new private item). Edit & re-run deep-links ?tool=<id>&layer=<key>#data using the existing Analyze guide ids. No recipe job table, no DAG, no param-manifest shell.
proposals.rationale: analyze-workflow-ux-2026-10-30 item 4. History is the missing shelf: Analyze already creates derived_layer items with source + pipeline metadata, and DerivedLayerDetail already renders the recipe. Deeplink + map quick actions shipped in v0.9.126; this closes the loop without a new engine.
proposals.risk: full=1 list can be heavy in large orgs — keep mine=1 + low limit, or add sourceItemId server filter in the same PR if needed. Do not claim recipe tool-run history (tool runs stay ephemeral). Do not build Edit-params dialog shell (analyze-param-manifests stays later). Skip What's new only if the shelf is clearly power-user; otherwise a short What's new line.
proposals.ethosFit: Guided Analyze re-run before raw JSON. Reuses PostGIS derived_layer items as history.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Past runs shelf under Analyze + Re-run duplicate + Edit deep-link; help note on derived-layer / Analyze; CHANGELOG + short What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public print token consumers
proposals.summary: PrintRenderController POST consume-render-token and internal/load-job are @Public with only global 300/min. Authorization is single-use render token, not anonymous scrape of catalog rows, but a Nest 60/min (or 30/min) budget still bounds token-guess / sidecar hammering without touching PDF render auth.
proposals.rationale: Only remaining non-byte @Public CPU-ish pair after R16 list/scrape drain. Low severity; optional behind honesty + history if queue wants a SEC slice.
proposals.risk: Chromium sidecar retries under load could hit 60/min. Prefer 60; keep token single-use semantics. CHANGELOG Security + api.md; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: Self-hosted hardening without breaking print preview.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on both Public print token routes; CHANGELOG Security + api.md; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Optional Nest throttle on STAC/OGC static landing docs
proposals.summary: STAC and OGC landing/conformance/api plus Records-catalog collection root remain @Public on global 300/min. They return static catalogue JSON with no findMany. Add 60/min only if the queue wants a final Public Nest sweep after print tokens; otherwise keep deferred.
proposals.rationale: Deferred R15/R16 behind list/scrape endpoints. Those shipped; this is the residual doc class. Lowest priority SEC.
proposals.risk: Harvesters polling landing often may hit 60/min. Prefer 60; leave byte/tile routes alone. CHANGELOG Security; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest DoS budget on public catalogue docs.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on static landing/conformance/api + catalog root; CHANGELOG Security; skip What's new.
